Name: A Pelican Town - NPC Expansion Mod
Author: AndrewJamesC
Description:
[size=3] ﻿[left]Introducing Kenzie and Thompson, two new residents of the town!﻿﻿ A Pelican Town was made to make Pelican Town feel more like a *real* town. I created this mod based off of some questions I've thought of while playing, as well as a need to tell some fun stories about the world of the game. I hope you have as much playing as I did making it! It adds 2 new maps, with stairs leading to them in Pierre's Shop and Lewis's House.

[b][u][color=#f4cccc][size=4]NPCs[/size][/color][/u][/b]
﻿[color=#c27ba0][size=3][b][u]Thompson, the Stressed Singer[/u][/b] [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]- [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4]Thompson has recently moved into the valley from Zuzu City, after leaving to pursue his only profitable interest - botany. His true passion, however, lies with becoming a musical superstar. His other occupations include novice music video filimg, casual sewing and, generally, everything! Watch as he grows to understand responsibility and how to balance his [/color][i]many [/i][color=#f4f4f4]talents out. He is marriageable!   [/color]
[size=3][color=#1e84cc][b][u]Kenzie, the Impossible Advisor [/u][/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][/size][size=3]Kenzie has lived in Pelican Town for almost a decade, serving as advisor,
political strategist, representative, receptionist- really everything, to the mayor. But why would someone so talented stay in such a lackluster position? Find out Kenzie's backstory in a tale of revenge and exploitation, and how serious politics can get, even in such a small town. While she isn't marriageable, she will still appreciate your company and services for the valley.[/size]

[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b][/size][/color][/left][/size]Made to be compatible with SVE and East Scarp (Kenzie will visit).

[u]If you're an NPC creator, contact me about making cross mod events[/u]! I'd like to add a few so the mod feels more interconnected with the greater Stardew Valley modding canon.

There's currently crossover events with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli & Dylan[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17315]Fievel Goes East Scarp[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]Aideen (From East Scarp)[/url].

Bugs? Report them! I'm in college so very on/off with my work, but I'll try to fix them when I can.

[b][u][color=#f4cccc]Thank you to...[/color][/u][/b]
﻿Hexus, for her video series on map making. I cannot explain [i]how [/i]much this helped me. I started this mod back in early 2021 for around 2 months before giving up because I could not get maps to work. I came back in November of 2022 and watched them and instantly got back into the swing of things. The series seriously helped me, and I'd recommend it to anyone looking into getting into modding.
﻿Chuyuc, Gnadi772, and TheFrenchDodo, for testing the mod out and giving great feedback after I sent the beta to the East Scarpe server. Speaking of...
﻿The East Scarpe Discord Server, for helping me with my art, coding - really everything! I wouldn't have made it without the help there.
﻿And most importantly, my amazing friend Vada, my most honest tester and only irl who actually plays the mod for me. She's the only person I know in real life who knows about this, and I couldn't have asked for anyone else better to know.
